decisions.rationale: Fix verified: t2Check now also extracts the string literal (including '+'-joined literals) passed directly to prepareStatement(...) and checks it for the placeholder. Ran t2Check in node: prepareStatement("SELECT id, name, city FROM customers WHERE city = ?") and a concatenated-literal form both pass; the String sql variable form still passes; an inline literal with 'Leeds', an inline literal joined with + city, and an inline '?' in quotes are still rejected with the correct specific messages.
